verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs for finer control and customization, editor-extension APIs, and official packages delivered through the Package Manager. A probe confirms the UPM registry serves keyless JSON for first-party packages such as the AI Assistant and Sentis inference library. missing for 10: substantive first-party detail on SDK languages, typed clients and versioning, machine-readable API reference (docs.unity3d.com has no llms.txt or .md mirrors), and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
